concrete_changes.before: This independence is the defining feature of a tensor — a multi-dimensional quantity whose components transform independently under coordinate changes.
concrete_changes.after: A multi-component score can be represented as an array. Calling it a tensor requires specifying how its components transform under coordinate changes; independence of scores alone is not enough.
concrete_changes.reason: Contextual editorial revision; preserves subject and narrows unsupported or templated wording.

concrete_changes.before: The Shadbala tensor describes planetary strength across six dimensions.
concrete_changes.after: The proposed Shadbala representation begins with six strength components. Its tensor character remains to be established.
concrete_changes.reason: Contextual editorial revision; preserves subject and narrows unsupported or templated wording.

concrete_changes.before: The seers who developed Shadbala were field theorists working without the formalism of differential geometry. They computed tensor components by hand, tracked gradients through decades of observation, and identified the symmetries and invariants through contemplative practice. The mathematics they discovered is the same mathematics that Einstein needed to describe gravity. The application domain is different. The tensor algebra is identical.
concrete_changes.after: The proposed field-theory reading is contemporary. It cannot assign differential geometry to the historical developers of Shadbala or claim equivalence with Einstein’s tensor algebra before defining the transformation laws and testing the calculations.
concrete_changes.reason: Contextual editorial revision; preserves subject and narrows unsupported or templated wording.

concrete_changes.before: The Shadbala tensor implicitly defines a metric on the space of consciousness. Strong planets curve the experiential space around them, bending the trajectory of attention and events toward their influence. A powerful Jupiter warps the consciousness metric toward expansion, learning, and optimism. A powerful Saturn warps it toward contraction, discipline, and endurance.
concrete_changes.after: A metric on experiential space would be an additional construction, not something the six scores automatically provide. Jupiter as expansion and Saturn as contraction can guide an interpretation, but neither description establishes curvature of attention or events.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: The three operate as a loop: Kha recognizes the field, Ba hosts the computation, La generates the resistance that makes the recognition precise. This is not a one-time calculation. This is infrastructure. The chart is recalculated every moment the field is present. The natal chart is a kernel. The transit is a process. The reading is a context switch. The Shadbala tensor is the memory map — and the memory map is alive only when the operating system is running.
concrete_changes.after: The natal chart as kernel, transit as process and reading as context switch make a useful engineering sketch. The sketch should remain separate from the unfinished mathematical construction. Keeping six strengths visible may already be useful without borrowing the authority of a field equation.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.
